searchText: Hi! I'm creating a Docker image to use the SMTChecker with Eldarica so that more people can try this configuration without having to go through the modification steps. Currently I'm downloading the `run_small.js` script from github and modifying it while building the image. I wanted to ask you if it was okay to include this file (via download or just the plain file) in the image repo <@!931197475870629939> Yea sure! imo the main annoying part is that we still need the custom solc-js branch to access the solver callback and eldarica properly. Hopefully we'll merge the PR today though, so you only need solc-js master branch also currently the eldarica set up does not output counterexamples/invariants, only the result. Those 2 are under development, I have a branch with some code for that but not ready yet oooh, been wanting to try this out. Drop the link if you don't mind once it is rdy 🙂 <@!931197475870629939> oh actually I told you the wrong solc-js branch we got the eldarica PR merged, so you can actually use solc-js' master branch! + the js script that I pasted (gist), modified to filtering `smtsolver.availableSolvers` to eldarica (or whichever solver you want) + modified settings + a recent soljson.js release
